reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed target-cell somatic calcium-imaging calibration against paired electrophysiology, structural 3D motion reference, neuropil/expression sensitivity and visual-response validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior paired-imaging/electrophysiology Methods, supplements or validated protocols to choose conditions and verify transfer.
The biological indicator expression/preparation route and functional delivered quantity are unresolved; no concrete lookup/calibration-to-choice procedure makes the preparation executable.

Marking sessions invalid for indicator saturation can remove a genuine performance failure. Technical detector corruption must be separated from valid high-rate indicator failure, retained and counted in validation coverage.

checks.quote: prespecified test comparing stimulus and baseline
checks.reason: No actual response test or multiplicity procedure for visual responsiveness across cells/stimuli is supplied, despite appropriate clustered detection uncertainty.

checks.quote: prespecified range of plausible correction strengths
checks.reason: No actual bounded neuropil parameter exploration or procedure deriving its bounds/grid and selection stop.
Raw/intermediate traces and recorded instrument settings are useful, but stable animal/cell/trial linkage and exact code/environment/processing versions are not specified.

Careful same-cell calibration with actual electrically verified counts, structural single-channel controls, common-clock timing, 3D reference/known-shift validation and held-out animals. Independent animal precision, blinded processing, expression-proxy caveats, one-to-one matching and false-positive denominators are good. Application-specific confidence-bound acceptance and a fresh validation cohort after changes support disciplined iteration. The session-invalidity rule must preserve biological saturation failures; specific checks own that limitation.
